note: Clause numbers and titles follow published summaries of Form 3CD; not yet verified against the official form text.

clauses.title: Depreciation allowable as per the Income-tax Act
clauses.derivable: Block-wise depreciation from the fixed asset register (rates from the depreciation pack).
clauses.user_input: Block of assets for each asset; opening WDV per block.
clauses.judgement: Put-to-use dates, adjustments for subsidy/GST credit, actual cost.

clauses.title: Amounts inadmissible: payments otherwise than by account payee cheque / draft / electronic mode above the limit
clauses.derivable: Cash payments above the limit from the day book (per voucher for expenses; per party per day for suppliers).
clauses.judgement: Exceptions under Rule 6DD; aggregation; amount inadmissible.

clauses.title: Sums allowable only on actual payment: closing balances to check
clauses.derivable: Closing balances of duties, taxes and similar ledgers.
clauses.user_input: Dates of payment after the year end.
clauses.judgement: Which sums are covered; whether paid by the due date of return.

clauses.title: Loans and deposits taken and repaid (principal only)
clauses.derivable: Loan register from the day book: principal by mode (bank, cash, journal), interest and TDS kept apart.
clauses.judgement: Whether each amount is a loan, deposit or specified sum; exemptions.

clauses.title: Receipts of Rs 2 lakh or more otherwise than by banking channel
clauses.derivable: Cash receipts of the threshold amount or more from the day book.
clauses.user_input: Name, address and PAN of payers.
clauses.judgement: Aggregation by transaction or event; exempt receipts.

clauses.title: Expenses on which tax may have to be deducted: list to check against TDS returns
clauses.user_input: Sections, amounts deducted and deposited, from TDS records.
clauses.judgement: Applicability of TDS to each payment.

clauses.title: Turnover, gross profit and net profit
clauses.derivable: Turnover, gross profit and net profit from the statements.
clauses.judgement: Definition of gross profit for this business.

clauses.title: Break-up of total expenditure by GST registration of the supplier
clauses.user_input: Split by suppliers' GST status from purchase records.
